native_minecraft_tests.note: Same four headless native test failures as the earlier addon-disabled baseline. Cause unresolved; not established live-server bugs.

power.formula: current tower nominal power * current catalyst strength * 0.9 ^ (total relay count - 1)
power.mixed_chain: Each tower applies its own catalyst once; universal decay and worst noise continue across changes.
power.wire_channel_bridge: Preserves the total relay count; further relay visits continue universal loss.
power.cutoff: No artificial percentage floor; native reach and total visit budget apply.

routing.dominance: At a fixed tower, discard an arrival if a lower count has equal or cleaner noise. Prune before expanding.
routing.cold_entrances: Seed all direct entrances; skip an entrance search when its descendants are already dominated.
routing.cache_key: entry tower, previous total relay count, pruning mode; scoped to an immutable network snapshot
routing.invalidation: Network discarded after antenna/channel/catalyst/config/eligibility changes and successful data-pack reload.
routing.live_inputs: Reapply entrance noise and evaluate moving receivers every packet. No frame/source/player/entity cache.
routing.source_copies: Ordinary repeated delivery materializes only its selected source per receiver.
routing.custom_predicates: Keep original count alternatives; independent callback copies and resulting carrier power participate in selection.

regressions.reference_comparison: Optimized frontier and custom-predicate fallback match the uncached full tower/count reference.
regressions.fixture_note: Near-tie wire fixtures use 100% A/B and 200% C, matched masts and actual count-2 B range. Fixtures clear out-of-template masts; final run used a clean generated test world.

benchmark.scope: Synthetic graph only; no receivers, world access, audio or networking.

persistence.note: Unchanged from 0.3.0. No migration code or network reset added. Upgrades from 0.2 still require loading each tower once.

limits: Synthetic packet bytes; real multiplayer voice playback not exercised.
Dedicated-client join/reload catalog exchange not exercised end to end.
Local benchmark timings are not server TPS or voice throughput guarantees.
